Date December 9, 35

Subject Letter of inquiry from Greek Consulate General regarding Police
records of certain persons.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the letter dated November 26, 1935 from
the Acting Consul General for Greece addressed to the Commissioner
of Police on the subject of two Greek subjects named KARRAS and
SARIDIS and a former Shanghai resident named SAM NEWHOUSE, I
have to state that there is a record of a Greek named ATHANAS
KAARAS alias CORAS. If due allowance is made for the difference
in spelling it would seem that this man is the ATHANASSIOS
KARRAS whose name appears in the said letter.
KAARAS is known to be a smuggler of Persian and Turkish
opium and morphine into Shanghai. His address is given as No.7.A
Miller Road and he was formerly connected with the BUSY BEE
Greek grocery shop in Hongkew Market. The age of this man is
roughly 26 years; he arrived in Shanghai during the year 1931.
The record of THEODORE SARIDIS is as follows :
Armed Highway Robbery : 29/6/28 sentenced to 15 years' imprison-
ment; to loss of civil rights; and to a fine of $6,000 - to be
paid to complainant. On 8/2/29 this sentence was reduced to
4 years and the civil action dismissed. He was released on
remission of sentence 3/10/31.
Receiving Stolen Property : 22/1/33 fined $200 or 100 days '
imprisonment (Fine paid).
Possession of Opium for Sale : For this offence he was sentenced
on 15/6/33 to 1 year and six months imprisonment and fined $200
or 100 days. On 28/7/33, while still in Gaol, SARIDIS was brought
before the Court to answer a charge of shopbreaking in Tientsin
on February 15, 1933. The offences were combined and sentence
changed to 2 years and six months and a fine of $200 or 100 days.
Provided SARIDIS pays this fine he will be released on December 30,
1935.

主题 希腊总领事馆关于某些人员警务记录的查询函。
由 D.S. Jones 制作 转呈 [签名]

关于1935年11月26日希腊代总领事致警务处处长的信函，信中提及两名名为 KARRAS 和 SARIDIS 的希腊籍人士以及一名前上海居民 SAM NEWHOUSE，本人谨此说明，档案中有一名名为 ATHANAS KAARAS（别名 CORAS）的希腊人的记录。如果考虑到拼写差异，此人似乎就是上述信函中出现的 ATHANASSIOS KARRAS。
据悉，KAARAS 是一名将波斯和土耳其鸦片及吗啡走私进入上海的走私犯。其地址登记为密勒路7A号，他以前与虹口市场的一家名为 BUSY BEE 的希腊杂货店有关联。此人年龄约为26岁；于1931年间抵达上海。
THEODORE SARIDIS 的记录如下：
持械拦路抢劫：1928年6月29日被判处15年监禁；剥夺公民权；并处以罚款6,000美元——支付给原告。1929年2月8日，该刑期减为4年，民事诉讼被驳回。他于1931年10月3日因刑期减免获释。
收受赃物：1933年1月22日被罚款200美元或监禁100天（已缴纳罚款）。
持有待售鸦片：因此项罪行，他于1933年6月15日被判处一年六个月监禁，并处罚款200美元或监禁100天。1933年7月28日，SARIDIS 仍在狱中时，被带上法庭，以回答其于1933年2月15日在天津犯下的破门入室盗窃罪的指控。数罪并罚，刑期改为两年六个月，并处罚款200美元或监禁100天。如果 SARIDIS 缴纳此罚款，他将于1935年12月30日获释。

    The only passport among the property of SARIDIS held
by the Gaol against his release is one issued him by the
Bureau of Public Safety at Hankow on November 21, 1931; valid
for one year only. On this passport he is described as a
merchant, born at Trafegond. His date of arrival in Hankow
is given as November 14, 1931 and his address as - New York
Restaurant, No. 8 Erh Yao Road, Hankow.
    SAM NEWHOUSE: Nothing has been heard of this individual
in recent years. On January 31, 1916 he was arrested in
Shanghai on a British warrant issued under the "Defence of
the Realm Act." He claimed to be a citizen of Brazil, and as
this claim was upheld by the Brazilian Consul in Shanghai at
that time, he was released. His Consul undertook to deport him
to Brazil before the conclusion of the Great War. In the
summer of 1916 he was heard of in San Francisco, at which
port he was in the habit of visiting ships from China. It is
not on record whether he was deported to Brazil, or whether
he left Shanghai of his own free will.

16th February, 1917.
REPORT ON Mrs. Rose Loggey.
Made by D. S. Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
Mrs. Rose Loggey moved into the Kalee Hotel on 13th instant.
and left again on 15th inst.
She said at the Kalee Hotel that she had come from the Astor
House, but inquiries go to show that this statement was
untrue. Her description answers that of a prostitute, a
Mrs. Newhouse, who has been in houses of ill fame in both Shanghai,
Hankow and Tientsin. Her husband, Samuel Newhouse, was
arrested on January 31st 1916 on a British warrent issued
under the "Defence of the Realm Act." He succeeded in
proving that he was a Brazilian subject and was consequently
set free, but his Consul promised to deport him from China
during the duration of the war. Newhouse was in San Francisco
last summer, when he used to visit the ships arriving from
China.
I have been unable to ascertain for certain if Mrs Rose
Loggey and Mrs Newhouse are identical. The latter is said to
be a clever and unscrupulous woman. She is Russian by birth,
but lived a great part of her life in Vienna. She speaks
Russian, German and English.
(批：Ack. 7.2.17)
(批：K.O 12/2)
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.
Chief Detective Inspector.

关于 Rose Loggey 夫人的报告。
由 D. S. Givens 制作。由首席侦探督察转呈。
先生，
Rose Loggey 夫人于本月13日搬入卡利酒店，并于本月15日再次离开。
她在卡利酒店称她来自礼查饭店，但调查显示此说法不实。她的体貌特征符合一名妓女 Newhouse 夫人的描述，该女子曾在上海、汉口和天津的妓院中出没。她的丈夫 Samuel Newhouse 于1916年1月31日根据《国土防卫法》签发的英国逮捕令被捕。他成功证明自己是巴西籍人士，因此被释放，但其领事承诺在战争期间将他从中国驱逐。Newhouse 去年夏天在旧金山，当时他常去拜访从中国抵达的船只。
我未能确切查明 Rose Loggey 夫人与 Newhouse 夫人是否为同一人。后者据称是一个聪明且肆无忌惮的女人。她生于俄罗斯，但在维也纳度过了大部分人生。她讲俄语、德语和英语。
(批：收悉 17.2.7)
(批：K.O 2/12)
我是，先生，
您顺从的仆人，
D.S.Givens

REPORT ON Mrs. Rose Loggey.
Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
Mrs. Rose Loggey moved into the Kalee Hotel on 13th instant, saying she had come from the Astor House. Enquiries at the latter place go to show that she never stayed there. She is believed to be a prostitute, but I have not yet got particulars of her antecedents. As far as I can learn, she is not the person who interested herself on behalf of Samuel Newhouse, the file about whom I am attaching.
I would respectfully suggest that Mrs Loggey be questioned re her movements anterior to the 13th instant. I would like to make further inquiries before passing an opinion as to whether it would be advisable to give her a passport or not.
Samuel Newhouse was in San Francisco last summer, when he used to visit the ships arriving from China.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J.S. Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Miss Kitty Lyall, Maiden name Kitty Stainfield,
was born in Hongkong where her mother kept a boarding-
house. Has one brother who was in the B. A. T. but
whose present whereabouts are unknown and one sister
Hetty (married). There are three branches of the
family and most of them are known for their loose
morals. A couple of local girls named Stirling
are cousins of Miss Lyall and another cousin is
married to one of the Brown family, (well known
Shanghai athletes).

Miss Lyall has been an inmate of Kiangse Road
brothels for about seven years. She has been mistress
of at least two houses and an inmate of several others.
She has toured Europe with Shanghai gentlemen whose
names it is better not to mention and lived in Shanghai
under the protection of others. She has led a very
hectic life, been in serious motor car accidents,
attempted suicide, etc.,etc. She was at one time
reputed to be a drug taker.

She was first married to a man named Loggey, but is
believed to have divorced him. At any rate she went
through a form of marriage in Africa with a man who
came to Shanghai as a traveller for a well known
armaments firm and on arrival in England was arrested
for bigamy and only escaped severe punishment through
being able to produce proof that a firm of Shanghai
lawyers had led her to believe that her marriage to
Loggey had been dissolved. Lovely woman Eh ?
page_data.zh:
Kitty Lyall 小姐，婚前姓 Kitty Stainfield，
出生于香港，其母亲在那里经营一家寄宿公寓。
她有一个兄弟，曾在英美烟草公司工作，但
目前下落不明，还有一个姐妹 Hetty（已婚）。
这个家族有三个分支，其中大多数人都以
道德败坏而闻名。当地有两个名为 Stirling
的女孩是 Lyall 小姐的表亲，另一位表亲嫁
给了 Brown 家族的一员（上海著名的运动员）。

Lyall 小姐在江西路的妓院中当了大约七年
的住客。她至少做过两家妓院的鸨母，并在
其他几家妓院中住过。她曾与一些上海绅士
同游欧洲，这些人的名字最好不提，并在上海
受他人庇护生活。她过着非常混乱的生活，
遭遇过严重的车祸，试图自杀等等。她一度
被传闻吸毒。

她第一次嫁给一个名叫 Loggey 的男人，但据
信已与他离婚。无论如何，她在非洲与一个男人
举行了某种形式的婚礼，该男子作为一家知名
军火公司的推销员来到上海，但在抵达英国时
因重婚罪被捕，仅因能够出示上海一家律师事务
所让她相信她与 Loggey 的婚姻已解除的证明，
才免于严厉惩罚。真是个迷人的女人，嗯？

Aphanacy D. Karrass, a Greek citizen, is known among the local Russian gamblers and thieves as "Karass", which means "Russian" in Russian. He appeared in Shanghai several years ago presumably from Harbin and became a notorious gambler in local Russian gambling circles. He and a Russian Jew by the name of Ginsburg, better known as "Little" Ginsburg have several times opened gambling dens for playing "Chemin de fer" and other card games. So far as the informer can remember the last den was raided by S. M. P. some time in 1934 and both Karrass and Ginsburg were arrested. S. M. P. probably have their photo and finger prints and other particulars.
It is also known that Karrass have a habit to meet Italian and German steamers and take

NAME
KARRASS, A. D.

delivery of pistols and ammunitions, which were brought up here by the members of the crew. However, the trade was not very profitable as the most he could dispose off was one or two at a time. There is no evidence that Karrass ever engaged in narcotics trade, but according to the informer, he is a type of man who could do it in a small scale as gambler always has no money.
A few months ago Karrass was hanging around at "Astoria Cafe" to do his business there, but now he has disappeared from that place he owes the proprietor about 50 dollars which he has consumed in tea and coffee. The proprietor, K. Dimitriadis, is reported to be one of the few honest Greeks in Shanghai.
Lately Karrass is hanging around at "Bosfor" Cafe situated at 582/1 Avenue Joffre. It is a dirty small dining room owned by a notorious "fence" Volodka Greek and frequented by local Russian pick-pockets shop-lifter, etc. Karrass seems to be pennylless at present and is now supported by the owner of Bosfor as he is helping the latter to arrange card games with the successful thieves.

Your Honour:

Subject A.D.Karras

I have the honour to charge the above Greek subject before your Honourable Court, for threating to assult me, using insulting expression, making unreasonable demands for money and treatment and for causing a disturbance at my office.

At about 10 o'clock this morning Karras called at this Consulate General and clearly threatened to assult me "if he could get me outside" the Consulate premises.

I had to telephone to the Police for assistance and the Police will inform the Court that he was only removed from my office with great difficulty and not before he threatened to destroy property of the Consulate.

The accused were originally a sailor but deserted his steamer in Vladivostock early in 1927. He arrived in Shanghai in July 1927 and has ever since made his residence in China. I attach his Police record for reference.

Some four or five months ago he assaulted another person (a Greek subject named Constantinidis) and was arrested by the Police of the French Concession and charged before the Second District Court.

Some three or four years ago he assulted another person (also a Greek subject by the name of Moatsos) and a record of this case should be available at the Boone Road Branch Police Station.

With considerable difficulty I have been able to enlist him as a sailor on the Greek s.s. "EVGENIA CHANDRIS" last July, hoping that in this way, I would obtain his repatriation to Greece. To my surprise he returned to Shanghai late last month without a regular visa, claiming that he has been ill and that he was sent by the Japanese Police of Yamatsu to my Consulate.

I have immediately arranged and obtained for him free medical and hospital treatment at the Shanghai General Hospital and have since been trying to communicate with his steamer to ascertain the cause of his departure or dismissal as he has returned to Shanghai without his Seaman's Book, which of itself is irregular.

本人荣幸地向贵庭指控上述希腊籍人士，罪名包括威胁袭击本人、使用侮辱性言辞、提出不合理的金钱和治疗要求，以及在本人办公室扰乱秩序。

今天上午10点左右，卡拉斯来到本总领事馆，并明确威胁要袭击我，“如果他能把我弄到”领事馆辖区“外面”。

我不得不打电话向警方求助，警方将告知法庭，他是费了很大力气才被带离我的办公室的，而且在此之前他还威胁要破坏领事馆的财产。

被告原是一名水手，但于1927年初在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）逃离其所在的轮船。他于1927年7月抵达上海，此后一直居住在中国。随函附上他的警方记录以供参考。

大约四五个月前，他袭击了另一人（一名名为康斯坦丁尼迪斯 Constantinidis 的希腊籍人士），并被法租界警方逮捕，并在第二特区法院被起诉。

大约三四年前，他袭击了另一人（也是一名名为莫阿索斯 Moatsos 的希腊籍人士），该案记录应在布恩路（Boone Road，今西藏中路）巡捕房存档。

去年7月，我费了很大力气才将他作为水手受雇于希腊轮船“EVGENIA CHANDRIS”号，希望以此方式使他遣返回希腊。令我惊讶的是，他上个月底在没有正规签证的情况下返回上海，声称自己生病，并且是日本山atsu（音译）警方派他到我的领事馆的。

page_data.en:
The Central Police Station vs DA. D. Karras.

Judgment:
A.D.Karras was sentenced to three months' imprisonment for uttering threats of violence against other one. After serving his sentence, he should be expelled from the country.

Facts:
A.D.Karras, recently reaching Shanghai from Japan, went to the Greek Consulate for the demand of medical treatment. The Greek Consul arranged and obtained for him free medical and hospital treatment. But Karras insisted that the Consul should provide for him funds and a doctor of his own choice. This was refused by the Consul. On 5th inst. at about 10 o'clock a.m. Karras again went to the Greek Consulate, 120, Jinkes Road, and asked for money, but this was still refused by the Consul. Then the defendant became unruly threatening the Consul Yannoulatos. The latter telephoned to the Central Police Station, officers from which took Karras into custody and brought an action against him to this Court.

Reasons:
According to the fact of this case, althought the defendant denied to use threats against the Consul, but his unlawful action had not only been proved by the Consul's representative, but also it was clearly stated in the Consul's petition. Furthermore, a witness named G. Stamatelatos attending to this Court said that the defendant had such an unlawful action. The defendant, therefore, cannot deny. This Court now applying to the Article 305 of the Criminal Code sentence the defendant to three months' imprisonment. On account of the defendant's former bad acts (which was stated in the Consul's letter and the Police Station's record) he should be expelled from the Country after serving his sentence. According to the Article 291 of the Criminal Procedure Law, the Court give the above judgment.
page_data.zh:
中央巡捕房 诉 D.A. D. 卡拉斯案。

判决：
A.D.卡拉斯因对他人发出暴力威胁，被判处三个月监禁。服刑期满后，应将其驱逐出境。

事实：
A.D.卡拉斯近期从日本抵达上海，前往希腊领事馆要求医疗待遇。希腊领事为其安排并获得了免费的医疗和住院治疗。但卡拉斯坚持要求领事提供资金和他自己选择的医生。这一要求被领事拒绝。本月5日上午10点左右，卡拉斯再次前往位于静安寺路120号（Jinkes Road，即静安寺路，今南京西路）的希腊领事馆索要钱财，但仍被领事拒绝。随后被告变得蛮横无理，威胁领事扬努拉托斯。后者致电中央巡捕房，该处警员将卡拉斯拘捕并向本庭提起诉讼。

理由：
根据本案事实，虽然被告否认对领事使用威胁，但其违法行为不仅由领事代表证实，而且在领事的诉状中也清楚陈述。此外，出庭证人 G. 斯塔马特拉托斯（G. Stamatelatos）称被告有此违法行为。因此，被告无法抵赖。本庭现依据《刑法》第305条判处被告三个月监禁。鉴于被告以往的劣迹（在领事信函和巡捕房记录中均有陈述），服刑期满后应将其驱逐出境。根据《刑事诉讼法》第291条，本庭作出上述判决。

阿塔纳西奥斯·迪米特里奥斯·卡拉斯（Athanassi's Dimitrios Karras），27岁，希腊司炉工，因威胁上海希腊代理总领事 E. P. 扬努拉托斯先生，昨天上午被第一特区法院判处三个月监禁。服刑期满后，他将被驱逐出境并遣送回希腊。

卡拉斯是根据扬努拉托斯先生的投诉，于周一中午前不久被中央巡捕房附属警察逮捕的。据后者称，卡拉斯当天上午来到他的办公室，提出不合理的医疗要求。这些要求被拒绝，随后据说卡拉斯威胁了该官员。

Greek Consul
Is Threatened
By Stoker

Will Be Brought Before 1st Special
Court Today

Because he walked into the offices of the Greek Consulate-General, 150 Jinkee Road, yesterday morning and made a series of threats against Mr. E. P. Yannoulatos, acting Consul-General for Greece, A.D. Karras, ship's fireman, will be brought before the First Special District Court this morning and charged under the Chinese Criminal Code with having uttered threats in contravention to family laws.

Karras, a Greek, resides in the French Concession. He was sent out of Shanghai early this year through the efforts of the Consulate-General but returned a few months ago. According to the Consulate, he was recently given free medical treatment at a local hospital, but this, it appears, left him unsatisfied.

He appeared at the Consulate-General yesterday morning and made unreasonable demands, it was stated, for more expensive medical treatment. His demands are said to have been refused whereupon he is alleged to have become unruly, threatening the acting Consul-General. The latter proceeded at once to call the Central Police Station.

Police were sent to the Consulate-General and Karras was taken to the station for questioning. He was still being held last night and will make his appearance in court at about 9 a.m. today.

受到司炉工威胁

今日将提审至第一特区法院

据说，他昨天上午出现在总领事馆，并提出不合理的要求，要求提供更昂贵的医疗服务。据说他的要求被拒绝，随后他变得蛮横无理，威胁代理总领事。后者随即致电中央巡捕房。

Greek Given Gaol Term For
Threats To Consul

Seaman Allegedly Demanded Money For Medical
Expenses Instead Of Agreeing To Be Sent To
Hospital; Bears Grudge Against Consul

Athanasios Dmitriou Karras,
27-year-old Greek seaman, was
sentenced to three months' im-
prisonment by the First Special
District Court yesterday upon be-
ing found guilty of uttering
threats of violence against Mr. E.
P. Yannoulatos, acting Consul-
General for Greece, at his office
at 120 Jinkee Road, on Monday
morning.

The trial was very short and
Karras objected very strongly at
being given no chance to obtain
the services of a lawyer or to
prove his case by calling witnesses
on his own behalf. Karras used
strong words against the acting
Consul-General for Greece, stating
that the Consul was "no good,"
that he would write to Greece
about him and that the local Greek
community was against their
Consul.

Karras also claimed that the
Greek official had a grudge against
him for political reasons and
begged the court to send him to
hospital for treatment. All these
requests were, however, denied
the accused and immediately after
hearing the evidence of a re-
presentative of Mr. Yannoulatos,
the judge pronounced the sen-
tence.

Several members of the local
Greek community appeared in
court after the trial and expressed
strong feeling at hearing that the
seaman had been sentenced.

Police Called

Evidence was given in court by
a representative of the Greek
official and by Detective Sergeant
Francis of Central Police Station.
Witnesses stated that the Consul
wished to have Karras deported.

The court, however, stated that it
had no right to do so. Karras
claimed that he asked the acting
Consul-General for hospital ex-
penses, but was refused.

The prosecution, however, con-
tended that the official offered to
put Karras in the General Hos-
pital, but that the latter refused
and wanted cash instead. Karras
contended that he had money com-
ing from the ship he worked on
and he asked Mr. Yannoulatos
to advance him money against
this. He also asked the court to
instruct the Consul-General to
telegraph the captain of his ship
and ascertain if this was not cor-
rect.

Karras complained in a loud tone
when sentenced. When informed
that he could appeal he pointed
out that he had no friends here.

Mr. Yannoulatos was re-
presented by Mr. M. Shikis.

希腊人因威胁领事被判监禁

据称水手要求支付医疗费而非同意送医；对领事怀恨在心

阿萨纳西奥斯·迪米特里乌·卡拉斯（Athanasios Dmitriou Karras），一名27岁的希腊水手，昨日在第一特区法院被判处三个月监禁，罪名是于本周一上午在金界路120号希腊代总领事E. P. 扬努拉托斯（E. P. Yannoulatos）先生的办公室内，对其发出暴力威胁。

庭审过程非常简短，卡拉斯强烈抗议未给予其聘请律师或通过传唤证人为自己辩护的机会。卡拉斯对希腊代总领事使用了激烈的言辞，称该领事“一无是处”，表示他将向希腊方面写信投诉，并称当地希腊社群都反对他们的领事。

卡拉斯还声称，该希腊官员出于政治原因对他怀恨在心，并恳求法庭将他送往医院治疗。然而，被告的所有这些请求均被驳回，法官在听取扬努拉托斯先生代表的证词后，立即宣判。

庭审结束后，几名当地希腊社群成员出庭，听闻该水手被判刑后表达了强烈的不满情绪。

报警方

希腊官员的代表和中央捕房警长弗朗西斯（Francis）在法庭上提供了证词。证人称，领事希望将卡拉斯驱逐出境。

然而，法庭声明其无权这样做。卡拉斯声称他曾向代总领事索要住院费用，但遭到拒绝。

然而，控方辩称，该官员提出将卡拉斯送入公济医院（General Hospital），但后者拒绝并想要现金。卡拉斯辩称，他有一笔钱将从其工作的船上汇来，他请求扬努拉托斯先生以此为由预支给他。他还请求法庭指令总领事向其船长发电报，核实此事是否属实。

卡拉斯在被判刑时大声抱怨。当被告知他可以上诉时，他指出他在这里没有朋友。

扬努拉托斯先生由M. 希基斯（M. Shikis）先生代表。
